Verify 0.45/0.65 and slot conservation without equating utilization to application speedup. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

In the two-thread case 650 useful+50 replay+300 wait=1000; useful utilization is 0.65, not 0.70. knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: POWER9的SMT模式讓同核心支援多執行緒；本課用合成發射槽觀測分析有用工作。
knowledge.textEn: POWER9 SMT modes support multiple hardware threads per core. Synthetic issue-slot observations track useful work.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 把槽分成有用、等待、重做三色，記各硬體執行緒擁有者；不要把執行緒數當核心數；.45/.65與槽守恆成立，報告不將利用率直接當應用速度比。
knowledge.textEn: Color slots useful, waiting, replay and record thread owners; thread count is not core count. Verify 0.45/0.65 and slot conservation without equating utilization to application speedup.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 有用利用率U=有用發射槽/可用槽，等待與重做都不計有用。
knowledge.textEn: Useful utilization U=useful issued slots/available slots; waits and repeated work are excluded.
